issuer: the North Carolina Division of Motor Vehicles (NCDMV)
note: The NC Driver Handbook (read 2026-10-30; its fees are those of the quadrennial adjustment of 1 July 2024) gives the Class C licence at $6.50 a year and its duration as 8 years when issued at 18 to 65, so the licence was kept as 8 years at $52 ($6.50 times 8, a product of the handbook's figures). It says drivers under 18 are provisional licensees and that at 18 an eligible driver may upgrade to a regular Class C licence, so a full licence is kept from 18. The state ID page gives the card free from 17 ($16.75 under 17), so the card is kept from 17 at no fee; its term wasn't read and is null. On 2026-10-30 the licence was rewritten with the terms set by the holder's age, from the handbook's duration table: 8 years at $52 from 18 to 65 and 5 years at $32.50 from 66 ($6.50 times 5, a product of the handbook's figures); until then it held the 8-year licence only. Later on 2026-10-30 both terms were rewritten to hold the handbook's rate, $6.50 for each year of the term, charged for each of its years, in place of the products worked out here ($52 and $32.50), which the file held until then.
